products.name: Bloomberg GPT
products.note: Finance-specific LLM; market data integration; proprietary data handling; trading decision risk

reading.body:
Bloomberg's only listed AI product is Bloomberg GPT, a finance-specific large language model built for market data integration and proprietary data handling, with trading decision risk flagged as a known concern.

The product note names three priorities: market data integration, proprietary data handling, and trading decision risk. That combination suggests an LLM aimed at financial workflows where data provenance and error control matter more than general-purpose conversation. The company was founded in 1981 and is headquartered at 731 Lexington Avenue, but the data gives no product scale, model size, or deployment numbers.

What the data does not show is equally clear. There is no compute footprint, no power draw, no building or data center information, and no case studies or MCP integrations. Any claim about grid constraints or physical infrastructure for Bloomberg GPT would have to come from outside this record.
